About me

A little about me.

I have a PhD in Computing Science from the University of Glasgow, where my research focused on stable matching problems, their mathematical structure, computational complexity and algorithms for solving them.

Outside my research, I volunteer as a Programme Coordinator for CSA Africa and mentor Year 10–12 students with Generating Genius.
